column1: # Ruby: modules (listed as packages), classes, constants assigned in a module or class body, and methods named as the source writes them: a setter (x=), an operator ([], ==, <=>, +), a constant (GET), a predicate or bang name, def self.x.

# attr_reader / attr_writer / attr_accessor define one field per literal symbol (a reader and a writer of one name are one field); alias, alias :a :b and alias_method :a, :b define the new name as a method;

# define_method(:name) and define_method("name") define a method. Not definitions: include / extend, a call, an instance variable, a local variable, and attr_reader or define_method with a name computed at run time.
